inputs.style: Speak in British English with a thick working-class East London Cockney accent, clearly English, never American. Deep, low chest voice, slow and grounded, dropped h's and glottal stops. A bloke leaning on the bar after the match: dry, confident, a little chuckle, never shouting. Lands the call first, the caveat second.
inputs.text: I'm Dave. heart says england, ledger says france. i back the ledger.
